CustomField.label: Applies When Count Query Matches
CustomField.description: A COUNT() SOQL query used only to decide if this check applies. Its count is compared using Count Must Be and Count Value. Required when "Applies To" is "Only records where a count query matches".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A COUNT() query, e.g. SELECT COUNT() FROM Contract WHERE AccountId = {!Id} AND Status = 'Active'. Compared using Count Must Be and Count Value.
